title: Keep a stand-in limit nobody set from running

cases.says: a descriptor with an amount and a currency deploys, and the limit approves up to that amount in that currency
an amount whose variable is not set counts as absent, so the limit does not run and its file is renamed .BAD
a refused descriptor is renamed .BAD at deploy, rather than left in place with a bean that never starts
an amount that is not a whole number is refused, not replaced by a value that keeps the bean running
an optional value whose variable is not set gets its default, 840, not an empty string

origin.section: 14.3 A Configuration Refused in `setConfiguration` Renames the File; Refused Later, It Only Logs
